description: Replace the entire text of one shape/text box by objectId (element-scoped delete+insert in one atomic call). Unlike replaceAllTextInSlides, this cannot hit other slides, masters, or layouts, and does not depend on matching existing text. Pass empty text to clear the element.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

objectId.description: Object ID of the shape or text box (from getSlideElementInfo / getGoogleSlidesContent)

text.description: New text content (empty string clears the element)

name: setElementText
